plan/summary.json.duration_scope: certified feasible candidate family; not a proven global minimum
limitations: yaw commands are added to the heading measured at launch; tangent mode requires the aircraft to start pointed along the initial path tangent
a periodic path starts and stops at its seam; extra laps repeat that loop
a circle exit unrolls each lap into one open path, flies the launch seam through, and stops at the exit; seam speed is the certified schedule
a circle entry flies a lead-in from launch and meets the seam without stopping
an explicit yaw profile is a certified fit to requested heading samples on one rest-to-rest piece
interior hard points are full stops; exact points are flown through
look-at yaw tracks one fixed point and is refused if the path can reach it
open_depart is refused because the runner lands from a final stop
unconstrained yaw is refused
obstacle clearance is claimed only for a hashed map bound to the environment
rotor allocation uses declared individual geometry with simultaneous roll/pitch reserve; actual torque demand remains an identification assumption
controller cruise height must match the compiled value
a SITL acknowledgement is not a clearance to fly
not a clearance to fly
SITL_ONLY
